headlines.title: Unifor autoworkers ratify contracts with GM Canada. What happens next?
headlines.summary: The new contracts include assurances that GM plans to invest over $1 billion Canadian dollars into its plants in Canada for new products.

headlines.title: Unifor members ratify contracts with GM securing new products, investment
headlines.summary: Unifor members at General Motors voted overwhelmingly to ratify contracts that secure new products and investment, while also delivering the wages and benefit improvements in the union's pattern agreement.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Is Under Pressure In The US Auto Market
headlines.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) faces fresh pressure on its long-held US sales lead as Toyota gains market share through hybrids. Toyota’s hybrid focused push in the US is narrowing the sales volume gap with GM and raises the risk that GM could lose its top automaker position. The shift highlights a clash between GM’s emphasis on higher margin trucks and SUVs and Toyota’s volume driven hybrid strategy.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Faces Safety Probe Over Engine Failures in Nearly 1 Million Vehicles
headlines.summary: On August 21, Reuters reported that the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened an engineering analysis covering 997,743 General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) pickups and SUVs equipped with the L87 V-8 engine.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
